_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0% base rate for ±2 point moves across 65 windows is the statistical truth — this is a coil, and neither the UP breaker (fed_liquidity >20 + CVD >40) nor the DOWN breaker (VIX >20 + funding negative) currently exists.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing the coil and absent breakers; narrative implies accumulation/bottom-is-in framing leaning toward eventual UP, though it does not explicitly call a direction. The analyst's structural divergence evidence overrides the narrative's pattern-level bullishness given Jordan's 7.67 trust weight on the analyst.
next_move.confirmed_if: HOLD — score remains within ±2 points over next 12h windows, validating the coil read
next_move.invalidated_if: LONG_AGGRESSIVE or SHORT — specifically fed_liquidity >25 + CVD >35 + stablecoin_growth >55 flips LONG; VIX >18 + funding <0 + exchange_netflow >85 flips SHORT
